asr.full_text: The NBA has been raiding the two separate call centers in Quezon City which are also selling pornographic sites to clients from other countries. This is what Carolyn Bonquin told us. 12 male employees had a online computer with the NBA located at Netu Waco Call Center in Novaliches. The files were full of details. We saw a rough and messy picture of the women, someaco Call Center at Novaliches was discovered last night. They were able to see any woman in men, even those who are underage. What is this, the use of the agents to keep a conversation between men and women. They create profiles through Facebook and various email accounts. And then they enter and greet online chat rooms and claim they are models. So once they triediced the client, they had the links to introduce him to her. There will be a client being charged. They will just sign up. What kind of page is this? Like the porn site, it is on the commission basis so like for a hundred or per sale But as the tenants say, they are just playing chats we don't show sensual things Like dating or being friends Even when they do not request, for example being nude and sexy usually it's sexy You Usually, all we really give is the sexiness. The 12 computers were stolen. The Call Center is operating for almost 2 months now and a former Barangay Gawad, a former financial agent has been involved. The group is also to find out if the client credit card is hacked. In another operation held by the NBI opened, they brought the number of woman victims, usually women, to the P.A. MicroSource Corporation. They also arrested eight men and a female call center police agent who were selling pornographic websites, too. They usually have a commission of 500. And if there are many clients who sign in to be foreigners, we will be able to charge them for more. the number of clients will increase. 6-12 years for the possibility of the people caught because of the anti-child pornography act. Caroline Bonquin for Umagang Balita.
